newsitem.title: USA: SOCCER-COLUMBUS CREW BEATS SAN JOSE CLASH 2-1.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-COLUMBUS CREW BEATS SAN JOSE CLASH 2-1.

text.p: Todd Yeagley's goal in the fifth shootout round gave the Columbus Crew a 2-1 Major League Soccer win over the San Jose Clash on Saturday.
Pete Marino, who scored the Crew's only other tiebreaker goal, put Columbus on the board in the second minute.
Robert Warzycha started the play by touching the ball to Jorge Salcedo at midfield.

Salcedo lofted a 35-yard pass down the right flank to the breaking Marino, who controlled the ball and sent a right-footed volley past goalie Dave Salzwedel and into the upper right corner of the net.
Jeff Baicher equalised for the Clash in the 50th minute, one-touching a crossing pass from Ronald Cerritos into an open net from the penalty spot.
San Jose's lone shootout goal came in the first round, when Shawn Medved was fouled by goalie David Winner and converted on a penalty kick.
The decision was the Crew's second shootout win of the season, and San Jose's second shootout loss.
Attendance was announced as 18,358 at Ohio Stadium.
